content.text: Section 24 matches the preferred position in full, and no change-of-control trigger appears elsewhere.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position on every material term: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or substantially-all-assets sale (24.1, with notice only); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct Customer competitor (24.2); other assignments require consent not unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed (24.3); and Customer's change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service (24.4). A search confirms no competing change-of-control or assignment trigger elsewhere — termination (§9) is limited to insolvency-type events, and §13.x expressly permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment. No redline needed.
